description: Mapping table between Unified Printing Taxonomy (UPT) entries and PTPGE Standard URIs. Regenerated 2026-08-27 against the current vocabulary: rows whose PTPGE target no longer exists were removed rather than repaired, so every row here resolves today. UPT equipment entries are largely out of scope by design — under the PTPGE catalog boundary, press models and material series are self-declared Layer 2 supplier catalogs, not Layer 1 terms.

mapping_types.exactMatch: UPT entry and PTPGE term refer to the same concept
mapping_types.closeMatch: UPT entry and PTPGE term are strongly related but not 1:1 (e.g., different scope or granularity)
mapping_types.broader: PTPGE term is a broader concept than the UPT entry
mapping_types.narrower: PTPGE term is narrower than the UPT entry
mapping_types.expanded: UPT entry maps to multiple PTPGE terms (PTPGE granularity > UPT granularity)

status_values.proposed: Mapping suggested by GutenLex Technologies AS, not yet confirmed by PRINTING United Alliance
status_values.confirmed: Mapping confirmed by both GutenLex Technologies AS and PRINTING United Alliance
status_values.deprecated: Mapping was previously asserted but is no longer current

mappings.ptpge_path: Ordering Process > Products > Buy Online > Sheets > Brochures
mappings.notes: UPT treats Brochures as a single level-1 category. PTPGE v1.0 expands this into 13 distinct Brochure Templates by fold mechanism — single-fold, tri-fold, z-fold, gate-fold variants (open/closed/double-closed), accordion-fold, tri-fold-stand, double-parallel-fold, cross-fold, cross-tri-fold, roll-fold. Each Template binds to one Setup Model with distinct Section structure. The brochures sub-category URI is the broader concept; the 13 narrower Templates are the addressable products. See PTPGE-Product-Model.md § 4 (granularity principle: one Template = one Setup Model).

mappings.ptpge_path: Ordering Process > Products > Buy Online > Sheets > Calenders
mappings.notes: Direct match. Note spelling: PTPGE uses 'calenders' (legacy from XMind source); UPT uses 'calendars'. The label is identical in meaning. PTPGE plans to standardise to 'calendars' in a future release (deferred to avoid breaking URI). UPT splits by Desk vs Wall at level-2; PTPGE may add these as narrower Templates when respective Setup Models are designed.

mappings.ptpge_path: Ordering Process > Products > Buy Online > Labels & Stickers > Stickers
mappings.notes: UPT treats Stickers as a level-1 category alongside Labels. PTPGE places Stickers as a sibling to Labels under the labels-stickers sub-category, following industry convention that Labels (functional, identifying) and Stickers (decorative, promotional) are related but distinct. closeMatch rather than exactMatch because UPT and PTPGE differ on whether Stickers are top-level or sub-categorised; the underlying concept is the same.

Maps to PTPGE Printing > Completions > Finishing > Coating (when added). Distinguish from substrate-side coating (the coating ON the paper before printing — that is Substrates > Paper > Paper Surfaces > Glossy/Matte/etc.). Coating-as-finishing is a post-press operation (varnish, aqueous, UV coating) — currently partially modelled in PTPGE via lamination Templates and varnish embellishments. A consolidated Coating sub-category in Completions/Finishing is planned for Phase 4.

regeneration_note.method: Rows dropped when the PTPGE URI no longer resolves against terms/; new rows only from label matches scoring >= 0.85; all rows remain status:proposed pending review with the UPT publisher. Rows with no PTPGE target but a reviewed note (UPT entries that span several PTPGE terms) were kept — they record judgement, not a broken link.
